page_title: JUV 2-1 LEC | Juventus v Lecce 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Nicolo Savona (Juventus).

87' 2 - 1 Goal! Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Thorir Johann Helgason, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot low inside the left post. What a finish that is - 2:1!
87' It seemed like Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
86' Lecce are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' Ante Rebic (Lecce) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
84' Tete Morente (Lecce) serves up a nice cross, but Michele Di Gregorio punches the ball away.
82' Lecce take a short corner kick.
81' A cross into the box from Tete Morente (Lecce) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.

81' Lecce slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
80' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
77' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) replacing Danilo Veiga.
76' The game has come to an end for Nicolas Gonzalez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
76' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.

75' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
74' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
72' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
70' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
67' A substitution has been made. Weston McKennie is replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
67' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus).
67' Today's match ends for Teun Koopmeiners who will be replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
66' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

64' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
62' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Lecce.
60' Juventus showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. It's a throw-in for Lecce.
56' Substitution. Konan Ndri (Lecce) in, Santiago Pierotti out.
56' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner but it's cleared.

56' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
54' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), but Wladimiro Falcone is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
53' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
52' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Tete Morente (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
51' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
50' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
49' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

48' Juventus slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Giampaolo decided to make a change. Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is replaced by Marco Sala.
46' Marco Giampaolo makes a half-time substitution. Ante Rebic (Lecce) comes on in place of Nikola Krstovic.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Wonderful movement by Lecce. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
42' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

41' Lecce slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

37' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
37' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
33' 2 - 0 Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.

32' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

31' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
30' The Juventus players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Lecce are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Lecce will take a throw-in.
24' The free kick is delivered by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
24' He should have scored! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
22' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
21' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
21' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' A long ball forward to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.

20' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
17' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
15' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Tete Morente (Lecce) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert to thwart the effort.
11' The free kick is taken by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus), but ball is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Marco Giampaolo is forced to make a change. Gaby Jean is unable to continue due to injury, Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) comes on.
10' Looks like Gaby Jean (Lecce) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' The game is interrupted now, Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) takes a good first touch just outside the box and unloads a shot without any hesitation that bounces off the right post. Not a bad try.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic displays great vision and sends a pass to Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
2' Excellent touch by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
